about: How easy mode's P describes this kit to an image generator (engine/imageprompt.gd). tail: the kit's style line. looks: what a model is, by id ({name, look, class}; class is wall, mounted, floor, centrepiece or corner). tag: the kit's id prefix.
tail: Utilitarian mid-century military and institutional furniture: olive-drab painted steel, brushed stainless steel, white porcelain, worn wood, canvas and paper; plain, sturdy, used, a little grimy.

chair_plain.look: A stacking chair: a bent steel frame, an olive seat and back moulded in one.

footlocker.look: An olive steel footlocker: lid, hasp and padlock, a stencilled number, carry handles.

cell_cot.look: A steel cot bolted to the floor: a thin striped mattress, a grey blanket folded at the foot.

stove.look: An institutional range: six burners on a steel top, two oven doors with windows, a splashback with the knobs.

prep_table.look: A steel prep table: a shelf under it, a chopping board, a knife rack, two pans.

toilet_stall.look: A toilet in its stall: two steel partitions, a door standing half open, the bowl at the back.

urinal.look: A porcelain urinal on the wall, a privacy screen beside it, the flush pipe running up.

weight_bench.look: A weight bench with its rack, a loaded bar across the uprights, plates stacked at the foot.

punching_bag.look: A heavy bag hanging from a steel gallows by a chain: leather, taped, dented where it has been hit.

firing_booth.look: A firing booth: two partitions, a counter with ear defenders and a box of rounds, a number board.

range_target.look: A paper target on a wooden stand: a black silhouette with its rings, holed.

restraint_chair.look: A heavy chair bolted to a plate: leather straps at wrist, ankle and brow, a headpiece on a gantry, its cable.

morgue_drawers.look: A wall of nine steel drawers, three by three, each with its handle and name card; one pulled half out, a shape under a sheet on it, a tag on its toe.

iv_stand.look: An IV stand: a five-wheeled base, a pole, a bag of something cloudy, its line.

surgical_lamp.look: A surgical lamp on a weighted stand: a jointed arm and a wide round head of lights, aimed down.

lectern.look: A wooden lectern: a sloped reading top with a brass lamp and a gooseneck microphone, the emblem plate on its front.

projection_screen.look: A tripod projection screen pulled up, showing a faint, flickering slide.

pin_board.look: A cork board on the wall: orders, photographs and a map, pinned and joined with red string.

map_table.look: A map table: a wide paper map of the sector under a glass top, counters, a ruler, and a lamp on a bracket.

signals_desk.look: A switchboard desk: a panel of jacks and lamps, patch cords hanging, a teleprinter with its paper, a headset.

typewriter_desk.look: A steel office desk: a typewriter with a sheet in it, a desk lamp, a stack of forms and a wire in-tray.

vehicle.look: A half-track: an olive armoured cab, two road wheels at the front and a track at the back, a pintle mount, a jerrycan and a spare. Longer than a cell is wide: it stands lengthwise.

vehicle_lift.look: A scissor lift for vehicles: two long platforms with hazard edges on scissor legs, a control post.

dead_scavenger.look: A scavenger who went in and came back out as far as the door: sat against the wall in a canvas coat and a helmet, pack still on, legs out, a note pinned to the chest.

garnisher_dispenser.look: A Collections Division dispenser: a steel cabinet with a lit COLLECTIONS panel, a coin-slot hatch the Garnishers come out of, hazard stripes, and a counter that only ever goes up.
